password.reassure: Your password stays on this device, encrypted. It is only sent to your mail server, or to our gateway for an IMAP mailbox, without ever being kept there.
password.tokenHint: Create a token in your mail provider's security settings (at Fastmail: Settings → Privacy & Security → API tokens). It replaces your password.

advanced.caldavHint: Address of the CalDAV service, e.g. found by /.well-known/caldav.

unreachable.text: Check your connection, then try again.

footer.security: JMAP mailboxes are reached directly; IMAP mailboxes go through a gateway that stores no password.
